def sha256(path):
 digest=hashlib.sha256()
 with path.open("rb") as stream:
  for block in iter(lambda:stream.read(1024*1024),b""): digest.update(block)
 return digest.hexdigest()

def write_json(path,payload):
 path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 temporary=path.with_suffix(path.suffix+".tmp")
 temporary.write_text(json.dumps(payload,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n")
 temporary.replace(path)

def input_root(kind,band):
 if kind=="native":
  return native_root/f"smacs-classical-{band.lower()}-inj512-20261011-r3"
 return montage_root/f"smacs-montagepy-{band.lower()}-inj512-20261011-r1"

def ready_report(kind,band,batch):
 root=input_root(kind,band)
 report_path=root/batch/band/"stackers.json"
 try:
  report=json.loads(report_path.read_text())
 except (OSError,json.JSONDecodeError):
  return None
 rows=report.get("rows")
 if not isinstance(rows,list): return None
 names=[row.get("name") for row in rows if isinstance(row,dict)]
 if len(names)!=len(rows) or len(names)!=len(set(names)) or set(names)!=expected[kind]: return None
 valid={}
 for row in rows:
  if row.get("status")!="OK": return None
  sci=pathlib.Path(row.get("product_path", ""))
  weight=pathlib.Path(row.get("product_weight_path", ""))
  if not sci.is_file() or not weight.is_file(): return None
  if sci.name!=f"{row['name']}_sci.fits" or weight.name!=f"{row['name']}_wht.fits": return None
  product_dir=(root/batch/band/"products").resolve()
  if sci.resolve().parent!=product_dir or weight.resolve().parent!=product_dir: return None
  valid[row["name"]]=(sci,weight)
 return {"path":report_path,"sha256":sha256(report_path),"rows":valid}

def link_or_check(source_path,target_path):
 target_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 if target_path.is_symlink():
  if target_path.resolve()!=source_path.resolve(): raise ValueError(f"staged link mismatch: {target_path}")
 elif target_path.exists():
  raise FileExistsError(f"staging target is not the expected symlink: {target_path}")
 else:
  target_path.symlink_to(source_path.resolve())

def stage_pair(kind,band,batch,method,report_path,report_sha,sci_path,weight_path):
 science=torchsky.read(str(sci_path))
 weight,weight_header=torchsky.read(str(weight_path),return_header=True)
 if science.ndim!=2 or weight.shape!=science.shape:
  raise ValueError(f"product shape mismatch: {sci_path} vs {weight_path}")
 if science.dtype is not torch.float32:
  raise TypeError(f"expected float32 CLI science product: {sci_path} has {science.dtype}")
 if not bool(torch.isfinite(weight).all()):
  raise ValueError(f"non-finite weight product: {weight_path}")
 support=weight>0
 if not bool(torch.isfinite(science[support]).all()):
  raise ValueError(f"non-finite supported science pixels: {sci_path}")
 target=merged/"b"/batch/"products"/"classical"/band/method
 target.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 staged_science=target/"prediction.fits"
 staged_weight=target/"support_mask.fits"
 link_or_check(sci_path,staged_science)
 casted=False
 binary_support_preserved=True
 if weight.dtype is not torch.float32:
  cast_weight=weight.to(dtype=torch.float32)
  binary_support_preserved=bool(torch.equal(weight>0,cast_weight>0))
  if not binary_support_preserved:
   raise ValueError(f"float32 support conversion changes positive support: {weight_path}")
  if not bool(torch.isfinite(cast_weight).all()):
   raise ValueError(f"non-finite derived support product: {weight_path}")
  derived=output/"derived_support"/band/batch/method/"support_mask.fits"
  derived.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
  header=dict(weight_header); header["BUNIT"]="1"
  torchsky.write(str(derived),cast_weight,header=header,overwrite=True)
  link_or_check(derived,staged_weight)
  casted=True
 else:
  link_or_check(weight_path,staged_weight)
 return {
  "kind":kind,"band":band,"batch":batch,"method":method,
  "stackers_json":str(report_path),"stackers_json_sha256":report_sha,
  "science_path":str(sci_path),"science_sha256":sha256(sci_path),
  "weight_path":str(weight_path),"weight_sha256":sha256(weight_path),
  "staged_science":str(staged_science),"staged_support":str(staged_weight),
  "science_dtype":str(science.dtype),"source_weight_dtype":str(weight.dtype),
  "staged_weight_dtype":"torch.float32","derived_weight_cast":casted,
  "positive_support_preserved":binary_support_preserved,
 }
